title: Identify walkthrough modules affected by code changes

fields.outcome: A maintainer or CI job can identify exactly which walkthrough modules need regeneration after an application code change and preserve modules proven unaffected.
fields.scope: Define a checked-in file-to-dependency map; compare changed repository paths to module views, controllers, API endpoints, and backend dependencies; emit deterministic regenerate, reusable, and review classifications through a library API and CLI. Support explicit changed paths and Git base/head ranges. Exclude source-language semantic analysis, automatic regeneration, remote asset harvesting, and publishing.
fields.acceptance: Given the captured profile walkthrough and a change mapped only to the profile view and endpoints, the invalidation plan marks update-profile for regeneration with concrete reasons and leaves sign-in reusable. Unmapped or stale mappings require review rather than being declared safe.
fields.changes: Implemented a dependency-map schema and example, deterministic library analyzer, conservative review classification, safe Git base/head collection including deletions and renames, an invalidate CLI with machine-readable output and CI exit status, fixture source ownership, package exports, documentation, and focused tests.
fields.decisions: Use a repository-owned JSON dependency map with portable glob rules and exact dependency identifiers. Keep matching deterministic and conservative: any unmapped file or dependency with no consumer prevents unaffected modules from being classified reusable.
fields.verification: Exercise exact and glob file matching, direct dependency matching, unknown-file handling, stale-map handling, deterministic JSON output, CLI explicit-file mode, and Git range collection. Prove the fixture profile page maps only to update-profile.
fields.dependencies: Builds on the module dependency fields captured by st-02 and the stable modular assets delivered by st-03 through st-06.
fields.risks: Repository maps can drift from source ownership. Broad globs can over-invalidate, while missing rules can under-invalidate; conservative review classification and stale-map reporting mitigate both.

criteria.expectation: A validated JSON document maps portable repository file globs to views, controllers, API endpoints, and backend dependencies.
A mapped change identifies only modules that consume at least one mapped dependency and records the matching file, rule, dependency kind, and value.
Modules with no matching dependency are marked reusable only when every changed file and mapped dependency is accounted for.
Unmapped files and dependency mappings with no module consumer are reported and place otherwise unaffected modules into review.
The analyzer can collect normalized changed paths from an explicit Git base and head without shell interpolation.
The CLI writes a deterministic machine-readable invalidation plan and returns a distinct nonzero status when review is required.
A profile-page fixture change regenerates update-profile while preserving sign-in.
